verbatim: 亚型按说明书适应症与临床维度切分：按适应症切出的四个亚型互不重叠；"老年与多重用药"与"慢性肾脏病或中度肝病等慎用人群"是横切的年龄与安全性维度，会与适应症亚型同时存在（例如一位 78 岁、合并肾功能下降的支架术后患者同时落在三个亚型里），因此这两行不与前四行互斥，也不用于分人群规模加总。
whyItIsWrong: ACS/PCI and recent-MI rows are called mutually exclusive without an exclusion rule that makes these categories disjoint.
note: Either define disjoint membership rules or label overlapping subtypes; avoid summing their populations. Keep the supported artifacts and calculations; correct or qualify the affected statement only. No human approval is required.
